caption:
i wasn’t gonna post this but the screen time math broke me. 2,190 hours on my phone. literally zero sitting with myself.
so i made one change. my phone locks until i write one honest thought. takes 90 seconds. and somehow my brain is quieter now.
still scrolling. just not drowning in it anymore.

#screentime #phonetok #journaling #mentalhealth #digitalwellbeing

she didn’t say anything for like 10 seconds. just looked at me. then asked if i’d ever tried actually writing my thoughts down instead of refreshing the same 3 apps. i said i tried but never stuck with it.

now my phone literally won’t open until i do. and my screen time went from 6 hours to 35 minutes in 2 weeks.

she asked what changed. i showed her my streak.

#journaling #screentime #therapytok #digitaldetox #habits
